old_caption: The video captures a breathtaking fireworks display over a serene body of water at night. The sky is dark, providing a stark contrast to the vibrant colors of the fireworks. The fireworks burst in various shapes and sizes, including hues of blue, pink, white, green, and red, creating a dynamic and colorful spectacle. Each burst illuminates the surrounding area, casting a warm glow on the water below, which reflects the fireworks' lights, adding depth and beauty to the scene. In the background, faint city lights and silhouettes of buildings can be seen, suggesting an urban setting. The camera remains static throughout the sequence, allowing viewers to fully appreciate the grandeur of the fireworks and their reflection on the water. The overall atmosphere is one of celebration and tranquility, with the natural and urban elements blending harmoniously under the dazzling fireworks.

caption: The video captures a nighttime fireworks display over a calm dark lake, with town lights on the left horizon and bursts mirrored below. Two large dome-shaped bursts of pink, white, and green streaks hang near center, their reflections stretching downward as sparks droop and dim. A thin vertical trail stays on the right, while nearby trails form small palm-shaped orange-white bursts that spread and fade. Higher up, several spherical bursts bloom into colored rings and bright cores, expanding across the upper sky with blue, green, and orange light. A red glow strengthens at the left edge of the launch line near the horizon, casting a red streak into the water's reflection. The lake mirror tracks the changing sky, shifting from fading central domes to brighter, more colorful high bursts. The camera remains fixed on the shoreline as the display continues.

claims of stillness, no motion, no camera motion or 'exactly' synchronized changes.

processes. Avoid deleting the real process merely because its cause lies outside the cropped window.
